cards.title: Sunset
cards.author: Amud
cards.script: function render(ctx) { return {title: 'Sunset', icon: 'sun', children: [{type: 'text', text: ctx.zmanim.sunset.time, style: 'headline'}, {type: 'text', text: ctx.location.name}]}; }

cards.title: Tonight’s Omer
cards.author: Amud
cards.script: function render(ctx) { return {title: 'Tonight’s Omer', icon: 'calendar', children: [{type: 'text', text: ctx.omerTonight ? String(ctx.omerTonight) : 'Outside the Omer season', style: 'headline'}]}; }

cards.title: Weekly parsha
cards.description: Upcoming Torah reading in Hebrew and English
cards.author: Amud
cards.script: function render(ctx) { return {title: 'Weekly parsha', icon: 'book', children: [{type: 'text', text: ctx.parsha.he, style: 'hebrew'}, {type: 'text', text: ctx.parsha.en}]}; }
